programme.title: The Ten Commandments (1956)
programme.desc: Raised as an Egyptian prince, Moses (Charlton Heston) discovers his Hebrew heritage, hears God's call, and engages in a bitter battle with the Pharaoh Ramses (Yul Brynner) to free the Jews from slavery, leading them to the Promised Land.

programme.title: Solomon and Sheba (1959)
programme.desc: Yul Brynner as the wise leader and singer of songs, Solomon, who finds his world turned upside down with the appearance of the wily temptress Sheba (Gina Lollobrigida). George Sanders, Marisa Pavan, David Farrar, and Harry Andrews co-star.

programme.title: No Way To Treat A Lady
programme.desc: A crafty serial killer plays a game of cat-and-mouse with a harried police detective trying to track him down.

programme.title: Top Gun: Maverick
programme.desc: Pete "Maverick" Mitchell keeps pushing the envelope after years of service as one of the Navy's top aviators. He must soon confront the past while training a new squad of graduates for a dangerous mission that demands the ultimate sacrifice.

programme.title: Jack Reacher
programme.desc: Investigator Jack Reacher leaps off the pages of Lee Child's novel and onto the big screen in this thriller. When a horrible crime is committed, all evidence points to the suspect in custody, who offers up a single note in defense: "Get Jack Reacher!"

programme.title: Top Gun: Maverick
programme.desc: Pete "Maverick" Mitchell keeps pushing the envelope after years of service as one of the Navy's top aviators. He must soon confront the past while training a new squad of graduates for a dangerous mission that demands the ultimate sacrifice.

programme.title: I Know What You Did Last Summer
programme.desc: After an accident on a winding road, four teens make the fatal mistake of dumping their victim's body into the sea. But exactly one year later, the dead man returns from his watery grave, and he's looking for more than an apology.

programme.title: I Still Know What You Did Last Summer
programme.desc: Remember Ben Willis? He's the fisherman who killed the boy who was driving the car when it went off the road in the fatal accident that killed his daughter, Sara... he's the man in the slicker with a hook in his hand... well, he's back.

programme.title: What Lies Beneath
programme.desc: The wife of a professor investigates the murder of a beautiful college student who has been appearing to her.

programme.title: The Pursuit of Happyness
programme.desc: Inspired by the true story about a single father and his young son. Finding themselves homeless, he risks everything on an unpaid internship in a highly competitive stockbroker training program, where only one in twenty interns make the grade.

programme.title: Fences
programme.desc: Set in the 1950s Pittsburgh, the film adaptation of August Wilson’s Pulitzer Prize-winning play takes a passionate look at former baseball player Troy Maxson as he fights to provide for those he loves in a world that threatens to push him down.

programme.title: Boyz n the Hood
programme.desc: Three friends struggle to survive in South Central Los Angeles where friendship, pain, danger, and love form a true picture of life in the 'hood in this critically acclaimed, action-filled story.

programme.title: Ong Bak
programme.desc: Raised by monks who taught him the Thai martial art of muay thai, Ting (Tony Jaa) is sent to Bangkok to retrieve the stolen head of the town's statue of the Buddha.

programme.title: The Protector
programme.desc: Kham, a young fighter must go to Australia to retrieve his stolen elephant. He must take on a gang led by two deadly bodyguards and an evil woman.

programme.title: Kill Zone 2
programme.desc: When his cover gets blown, a Hong Kong cop (Wu Jing) lands in a Thai prison where the warden works with a criminal mastermind (Louis Koo) to harvest organs.

programme.title: Daddy's Home
programme.desc: Will Ferrell & Mark Wahlberg face off in this Dad vs Step-Dad showdown! Brad (Ferrell) wants to be the best step-dad to his new wife's kids. But when their actual father Dusty (Wahlberg) shows up, the two must go toe-to-toe in this fun family comedy.

programme.title: Walk Hard: The Dewey Cox Story
programme.desc: Dewey Cox had it all: the women (over 411), the friends (Elvis) and the rock 'n' roll lifestyle (every pill and powder). But most of all, he had the music that transformed a dimwitted country boy into the greatest American rock star who never lived.

programme.title: Drugstore June
programme.desc: After the pharmacy in her small town is robbed, a girl who still lives at home with her parents takes matters into her own hands to solve the crime, while at the same time trying to get over her ex-boyfriend and become more of an adult.

programme.title: Dreamland
programme.desc: Discovering a fugitive bank robber (Margot Robbie) is hiding in his small town, a young man is torn between claiming the bounty on her head and his growing attraction to the seductive criminal, in this epic love story set during the Great Depression.

programme.title: Titanic
programme.desc: Leonardo DiCaprio and Oscar-nominee Kate Winslet light up the screen as Jack and Rose, the young lovers who find one another on the maiden voyage of the "unsinkable" R.M.S. Titanic.

programme.title: Stardust
programme.desc: In hopes of wooing a girl, Tristan promises to bring her a falling star. He soon discovers the star is actually a celestial beauty named Yvaine. When an old witch Lamia attempts to steal Yvaine's youth, Tristan must protect her.

programme.title: The Sum of All Fears
programme.desc: East-West tensions erupt when the CIA suspects that renegade Russian scientists are developing more nuclear weapons.

programme.title: Jack Ryan: Shadow Recruit
programme.desc: Jack Ryan must quickly evolve from soldier to analyst to full-fledged operative to stop a devastating terrorist plot against the United States.

programme.title: The Hunt for Red October
programme.desc: A new technologically-superior Soviet nuclear sub is heading for the U.S. coast; however, one CIA analyst thinks the captain will defect the submarine, and he only has hours to prove it.

programme.title: Regarding Henry
programme.desc: Henry Turner is a New York lawyer who needs to win at any cost. But a single gunshot brings Henry’s fast-track rise to a dead stop, leaving him incapacitated and with no memory of the life he used to lead.

programme.title: An Unfinished Life
programme.desc: Einar Gilkyson (Robert Redford) lives on a Wyoming ranch with his only friend, Mitch (Morgan Freeman). Then, suddenly, the woman he blames for his son's death arrives at his door broke, desperate, and with a granddaughter he's never known.

programme.title: Licorice Pizza
programme.desc: Licorice Pizza' is the story of Alana Kane and Gary Valentine growing up, running around and falling in love in the San Fernando Valley, 1973. Written and Directed by Paul Thomas Anderson, the film tracks the treacherous navigation of first love.

programme.title: The Magnificent Seven (2016)
programme.desc: Director Antoine Fuqua brings his modern vision to the classic western, a story of seven outlaws who join together to save a town from an evil industrialist! Denzel Washington, Chris Pratt, Ethan Hawke and Vincent D'Onofrio and Peter Sarsgaard star!

programme.title: True Grit (2010)
programme.desc: True Grit is a powerful story of vengeance and valor set in an unforgiving and unpredictable frontier where justice is simple and mercy is rare.

programme.title: No Country For Old Men
programme.desc: Winner of four Academy Awards, including Best Picture, filmmakers Joel and Ethan Coen (FARGO) bring to the screen a thrilling bestseller in which a crime-scene's irresistible stolen loot sets forth an unstoppable chain reaction of violence.

programme.title: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Air, Water, Earth, Fire. Four nations are tied by destiny when Fire launches war against the others. Caught between the war, one Avatar discovers he's able to manipulate all four elements.

programme.title: Evolution
programme.desc: A firefighting cadet, two college professors, and a geeky-but-sexy government scientist work against an alien organism that has been rapidly evolving ever since its arrival on Earth inside a meteor.

programme.title: Galaxy Quest
programme.desc: Nearly twenty years after the cult TV show Galaxy Quest was cancelled, the alumni cast is asked for help by an alien species in order to save the universe.

programme.title: Billboard Dad
programme.desc: To cheer up their widowed father, a workaholic artist named Max, Tess and Emily Tyler take out a personal ad on a Los Angeles billboard. Although Max receives an overwhelming number of responses, magic strikes when he meets Brooke Anders.

programme.title: Getting Even With Dad
programme.desc: Macaulay Culkin is a clever kid out to reform his small-time crook father (Ted Danson) in this exuberantly zany and heartwarming comedy for the whole family.

programme.title: The Brady Bunch Movie

programme.title: Solomon and Sheba (1959)

programme.title: No Way To Treat A Lady
programme.desc: A crafty serial killer plays a game of cat-and-mouse with a harried police detective trying to track him down.

programme.title: Attack On The Iron Coast
programme.desc: During the World War II occupation of France, the heart and strength of the German Navy sits in a heavily guarded port known as the Iron Coast – and it’ll take a crackerjack team of Allied commandos led by Lloyd Bridges to destroy it.

programme.title: Top Gun: Maverick
programme.desc: Pete "Maverick" Mitchell keeps pushing the envelope after years of service as one of the Navy's top aviators. He must soon confront the past while training a new squad of graduates for a dangerous mission that demands the ultimate sacrifice.

programme.title: Jack Reacher
programme.desc: Investigator Jack Reacher leaps off the pages of Lee Child's novel and onto the big screen in this thriller. When a horrible crime is committed, all evidence points to the suspect in custody, who offers up a single note in defense: "Get Jack Reacher!"

programme.title: Braveheart
programme.desc: William Wallace, a commoner, unites the 13th Century Scots in their battle to overthrow English rule.

programme.title: What Lies Beneath
programme.desc: The wife of a professor investigates the murder of a beautiful college student who has been appearing to her.

programme.title: Hide And Seek
programme.desc: A wealthy businessman searching for his missing brother is drawn into a dark underworld that threatens his sanity and his family.

programme.title: Hush
programme.desc: A deaf and mute writer who retreated into the woods to live a solitary life must fight for her life in silence when a masked killer appears at her window.

programme.title: Boyz n the Hood
programme.desc: Three friends struggle to survive in South Central Los Angeles where friendship, pain, danger, and love form a true picture of life in the 'hood in this critically acclaimed, action-filled story.

programme.title: Purple Rain
programme.desc: Rock star Prince makes a spectacular feature film debut in this highly autobiographical blockbuster that won both an Oscar and a Grammy award.

programme.title: Fences
programme.desc: Set in the 1950s Pittsburgh, the film adaptation of August Wilson’s Pulitzer Prize-winning play takes a passionate look at former baseball player Troy Maxson as he fights to provide for those he loves in a world that threatens to push him down.

programme.title: Kill Zone 2
programme.desc: When his cover gets blown, a Hong Kong cop (Wu Jing) lands in a Thai prison where the warden works with a criminal mastermind (Louis Koo) to harvest organs.

programme.title: Paradox
programme.desc: When his daughter goes missing, a police negotiator (Louis Koo) teams with local police (Tony Jaa) to find her, but instead finds himself embroiled in a web of corruption and violence in this explosive thriller from director Wilson Yip.

programme.title: Triple Threat
programme.desc: This breakneck thriller teams over half a dozen of the world’s biggest action stars for the martial arts event film of the year. When a hit is taken out on a billionaire’s daughter, it’s mercenaries versus assassins in an all-out war.

programme.title: Drugstore June
programme.desc: After the pharmacy in her small town is robbed, a girl who still lives at home with her parents takes matters into her own hands to solve the crime, while at the same time trying to get over her ex-boyfriend and become more of an adult.

programme.title: Clue
programme.desc: Meet all the notorious suspects and discover all their foul play things. You'll love their dastardly doings as the bodies and the laughs pile up before your eyes. Featuring all three surprise endings!!

programme.title: Wagons East!
programme.desc: They came for gold, but now they'll settle for indoor plumbing. John Candy and Richard Lewis star in this hilariously unconventional look at the legendary West.

programme.title: Titanic
programme.desc: Leonardo DiCaprio and Oscar-nominee Kate Winslet light up the screen as Jack and Rose, the young lovers who find one another on the maiden voyage of the "unsinkable" R.M.S. Titanic.

programme.title: Stardust
programme.desc: In hopes of wooing a girl, Tristan promises to bring her a falling star. He soon discovers the star is actually a celestial beauty named Yvaine. When an old witch Lamia attempts to steal Yvaine's youth, Tristan must protect her.

programme.title: Dreamland
programme.desc: Discovering a fugitive bank robber (Margot Robbie) is hiding in his small town, a young man is torn between claiming the bounty on her head and his growing attraction to the seductive criminal, in this epic love story set during the Great Depression.

programme.title: The Hunt for Red October
programme.desc: A new technologically-superior Soviet nuclear sub is heading for the U.S. coast; however, one CIA analyst thinks the captain will defect the submarine, and he only has hours to prove it.

programme.title: Patriot Games
programme.desc: Jack Ryan is caught in the middle of a terrorist attack. Ryan helps to thwart Holmes’ assailants and becomes a local hero. But Ryan’s act marks him as a target. Now he must return to action to save his family.

programme.title: Clear and Present Danger
programme.desc: When his mentor Admiral James Greer becomes ill, Ryan is appointed acting CIA Director of Intelligence.

programme.title: Licorice Pizza
programme.desc: Licorice Pizza' is the story of Alana Kane and Gary Valentine growing up, running around and falling in love in the San Fernando Valley, 1973. Written and Directed by Paul Thomas Anderson, the film tracks the treacherous navigation of first love.

programme.title: Eddie and the Cruisers
programme.desc: A reporter begins tracking down rumors of an unreleased album by a rock band whose charismatic leader disappeared after an accident and was presumed dead years before.

programme.title: Beautiful Boy
programme.desc: Bill (Michael Sheen) and Kate’s (Maria Bello) already strained marriage is tested when their college-age son commits a shocking act of violence that reverberates across the country.

programme.title: No Country For Old Men
programme.desc: Winner of four Academy Awards, including Best Picture, filmmakers Joel and Ethan Coen (FARGO) bring to the screen a thrilling bestseller in which a crime-scene's irresistible stolen loot sets forth an unstoppable chain reaction of violence.

programme.title: Forsaken (2014)
programme.desc: In 1872, an embittered gunslinger named John Henry Clayton attempts to make amends with his estranged father, Reverend Samuel Clayton, while their community is besieged by ruthless land-grabbers.

programme.title: Dead Man
programme.desc: On the run after murdering a man, accountant William Blake encounters a strange Native American man named Nobody who prepares him for his journey into the spiritual world.

programme.title: Galaxy Quest
programme.desc: Nearly twenty years after the cult TV show Galaxy Quest was cancelled, the alumni cast is asked for help by an alien species in order to save the universe.

programme.title: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Air, Water, Earth, Fire. Four nations are tied by destiny when Fire launches war against the others. Caught between the war, one Avatar discovers he's able to manipulate all four elements.

programme.title: Evolution
programme.desc: A firefighting cadet, two college professors, and a geeky-but-sexy government scientist work against an alien organism that has been rapidly evolving ever since its arrival on Earth inside a meteor.

programme.title: The Brady Bunch Movie
programme.desc: Mike and Carol have just one week to come up with $20,000 in back taxes, or they’ll lose their house to a neighbor. Even worse, Marcia gets a swollen nose on date night, Cindy’s addicted to tattling, and Jan’s hearing a psychotic inner voice.

programme.title: A Very Brady Sequel
programme.desc: Mike (Gary Cole) is a planning a surprise wedding anniversary party for Carol (Shelly Long) - until Carol's long-lost first husband, Roy (Tim Matheson), shows up to shake the family tree.

programme.title: Julie & Julia
programme.desc: Julie & Julia, tells the true stories of how Julia Child's life and cookbook inspired fledgling writer Julie Powell to whip up 524 recipes in 365 days and introduce a new generation to the magic of French cooking.

programme.title: Showgirls
programme.desc: Seduction, passion and power struggles unfold as the creators of Basic Instinct blow the lid off the seemingly glamorous world of Las Vegas showdancing in this controversial film that stars Elizabeth Berkley.

programme.title: The Boondock Saints
programme.desc: Two Irish Catholic brothers become vigilantes and wipe out Boston's criminal underworld in the name of God.

programme.title: Frank Miller's Sin City
programme.desc: In these intertwined tales, a universe of unlikely and reluctant heroes try to do the right thing in a city that refuses to care.

programme.title: Mother's Day (2012)
programme.desc: Rebecca DeMornay is terrifying in this brutal gorefest. When her sons break into a home and take the owners hostage, she teaches them what real torture is all about. Costars Shawn Ashmore.

programme.title: Tragedy Girls
programme.desc: A twist on the slasher genre, following two death-obsessed teenage girls who use their online show about real-life tragedies to send their small mid-western town into a frenzy, and cement their legacy as modern horror legends.

programme.title: Cobweb
programme.desc: Peter confides in his parents (Lizzy Caplan, Antony Starr) about mysterious tapping in his bedroom wall, but they say it’s just an old house. As his fear grows, so do his doubts.

programme.title: The Goonies
programme.desc: With brothers Mikey and Brand's house slated for demolition by greedy developers, the boys' only hope lies in finding a long-lost treasure. They uncover a treasure map and, with their friends, descend to a subterranean sea and an abandoned galleon.

programme.title: Gremlins
programme.desc: The rules for a Mogwai are simple: Keep your Mogwai away from water, bright lights and, most importantly, never feed him after midnight. But in Kingston Falls the rules are broken, and the consequences multiply at an alarming rate.

programme.title: Summer Rental
programme.desc: Comedy sensation John Candy plays the stressed-out air traffic controller whose much-needed family holiday yields one hysterical misadventure after another.

programme.title: The Phantom
programme.desc: The story begins as an expedition lands on the island of Bengalla, seeking the Skulls of Touganda. Believed to harness an energy force of power, they could spell disaster for mankind.

programme.title: Days of Thunder
programme.desc: Discovered by businessman Tim Daland, Cole is teamed with legendary crew chief and car-builder Harry Hogge to race for the Winston Cup at the Daytona 500. A crash nearly ends Cole’s career and he must turn to a beautiful doctor to regain his nerve.

programme.title: Flight of the Intruder
programme.desc: The target: a missile depot in Hanoi. The plane: the A-6 Intruder, a low-altitude bomber with no defensive weapons. The risk: court-martial at the hands of Commander Camparelli...if they live to return.

programme.title: The Godfather
programme.desc: A chilling portrait of the Corleone family's rise and near fall from power in America along with balancing the story of the Sicilian clan's ugly crime business in which they are engaged.

programme.title: The Godfather Part II
programme.desc: The continuing saga of a young Vito Corleone growing up in Sicily and in New York during the 1910s and then following Michael Corleone in the 1950s as he tries to expand the family business.

programme.title: Mario Puzo's The Godfather Coda: The Death of Michael Corleone
programme.desc: Director/screenwriter Francis Ford Coppola's definitive new edit and restoration of THE GODFATHER: PART III, with remastered picture and sound. Michael Corleone (Pacino) seeks to free his family from crime and find a suitable successor to his empire.

programme.title: The Whale

programme.title: The Bridges at Toko-Ri

programme.title: Stalag 17

programme.title: Jack Reacher

programme.title: Braveheart
programme.desc: William Wallace, a commoner, unites the 13th Century Scots in their battle to overthrow English rule.

programme.title: Gladiator
programme.desc: A man robbed of his name and his dignity strives to win them back, and gain the freedom of his people, in this epic historical drama from director Ridley Scott.

programme.title: Hush
programme.desc: A deaf and mute writer who retreated into the woods to live a solitary life must fight for her life in silence when a masked killer appears at her window.

programme.title: Cabin Fever
programme.desc: A group of kids are trapped in the woods and methodically killed off by a horrifying flesh-eating virus.

programme.title: The Ruins
programme.desc: "The Ruins" follows a group of friends who become entangled in a struggle for survival after visiting a remote archaeological dig in the Mexican jungle where they discover something deadly living among the ruins.

programme.title: Purple Rain
programme.desc: Rock star Prince makes a spectacular feature film debut in this highly autobiographical blockbuster that won both an Oscar and a Grammy award.

programme.title: Fences
programme.desc: Set in the 1950s Pittsburgh, the film adaptation of August Wilson’s Pulitzer Prize-winning play takes a passionate look at former baseball player Troy Maxson as he fights to provide for those he loves in a world that threatens to push him down.

programme.title: Boyz n the Hood
programme.desc: Three friends struggle to survive in South Central Los Angeles where friendship, pain, danger, and love form a true picture of life in the 'hood in this critically acclaimed, action-filled story.

programme.title: Triple Threat
programme.desc: This breakneck thriller teams over half a dozen of the world’s biggest action stars for the martial arts event film of the year. When a hit is taken out on a billionaire’s daughter, it’s mercenaries versus assassins in an all-out war.

programme.title: Striking Rescue
programme.desc: Tony Jaa is in top form as Bai An, a muay thai expert seeking revenge against the men who brutally murdered his wife and child. Jaa dominates the screen with powerful flying knees and elbows, proving he’s still one of the best there is.

programme.title: Ong Bak
programme.desc: Raised by monks who taught him the Thai martial art of muay thai, Ting (Tony Jaa) is sent to Bangkok to retrieve the stolen head of the town's statue of the Buddha.

programme.title: Wagons East!
programme.desc: They came for gold, but now they'll settle for indoor plumbing. John Candy and Richard Lewis star in this hilariously unconventional look at the legendary West.

programme.title: Grumpy Old Men
programme.desc: Jack Lemmon and Walter Matthau portray lifelong feuding neighbors making each day a hilarious game of revenge. But then voluptuous Ariel moves in nearby and their dormant hormones reignite in an all-out competition to win her favor.

programme.title: Grumpier Old Men
programme.desc: In this sequel to Grumpy Old Men, a vivacious Italian beauty attempts to convert Wabasha, Minnesota's cherished bait store into a romantic Italian restaurant.

programme.title: Dreamland
programme.desc: Discovering a fugitive bank robber (Margot Robbie) is hiding in his small town, a young man is torn between claiming the bounty on her head and his growing attraction to the seductive criminal, in this epic love story set during the Great Depression.

programme.title: Titanic
programme.desc: Leonardo DiCaprio and Oscar-nominee Kate Winslet light up the screen as Jack and Rose, the young lovers who find one another on the maiden voyage of the "unsinkable" R.M.S. Titanic.

programme.title: The Miseducation of Cameron Post
programme.desc: Based on the celebrated novel by Emily M. Danforth, this film follows the titular character (Chloë Grace Moretz) as she is sent to a gay conversion therapy center after getting caught with another girl in the back seat of a car on prom night.

programme.title: Patriot Games
programme.desc: Jack Ryan is caught in the middle of a terrorist attack. Ryan helps to thwart Holmes’ assailants and becomes a local hero. But Ryan’s act marks him as a target. Now he must return to action to save his family.

programme.title: Clear and Present Danger
programme.desc: When his mentor Admiral James Greer becomes ill, Ryan is appointed acting CIA Director of Intelligence.

programme.title: The Sum of All Fears
programme.desc: East-West tensions erupt when the CIA suspects that renegade Russian scientists are developing more nuclear weapons.

programme.title: Eddie and the Cruisers
programme.desc: A reporter begins tracking down rumors of an unreleased album by a rock band whose charismatic leader disappeared after an accident and was presumed dead years before.

programme.title: Beautiful Boy
programme.desc: Bill (Michael Sheen) and Kate’s (Maria Bello) already strained marriage is tested when their college-age son commits a shocking act of violence that reverberates across the country.

programme.title: After Yang
programme.desc: When his daughter's beloved A.I. companion malfunctions, Jake (Colin Farrell) uncovers details of the robot's previously unknown life hidden in the android's interior core, leading Jake to surprising discoveries about himself & his family.

programme.title: Forsaken (2014)
programme.desc: In 1872, an embittered gunslinger named John Henry Clayton attempts to make amends with his estranged father, Reverend Samuel Clayton, while their community is besieged by ruthless land-grabbers.

programme.title: Dead Man
programme.desc: On the run after murdering a man, accountant William Blake encounters a strange Native American man named Nobody who prepares him for his journey into the spiritual world.

programme.title: Little Big Man
programme.desc: From director Arthur Penn (BONNIE AND CLYDE), Dustin Hoffman, Chief Dan George, Faye Dunaway, Martin Balsam, Jeff Corey and Richard Mulligan star in a genre-defying tale of an alleged 121-year-old white survivor of Custer's Last Stand.

programme.title: Evolution
programme.desc: A firefighting cadet, two college professors, and a geeky-but-sexy government scientist work against an alien organism that has been rapidly evolving ever since its arrival on Earth inside a meteor.

programme.title: Galaxy Quest
programme.desc: Nearly twenty years after the cult TV show Galaxy Quest was cancelled, the alumni cast is asked for help by an alien species in order to save the universe.

programme.title: Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: The world needed a hero; we got a hedgehog. Superpowered with speed, Sonic races to save the world and stop evil genius Dr. Robotnik from world domination. Jim Carrey, Ben Schwartz, and James Marsden star in the adventure that the whole family will enjoy.

programme.title: Julie & Julia
programme.desc: Julie & Julia, tells the true stories of how Julia Child's life and cookbook inspired fledgling writer Julie Powell to whip up 524 recipes in 365 days and introduce a new generation to the magic of French cooking.

programme.title: Windtalkers
programme.desc: True story about members of the Navajo tribe who proudly served the U.S. in WW II as code talkers by using their native language as a code to relay information to military leaders.

programme.title: Hollywood Homicide
programme.desc: A pair of detectives investigate a murder while pursuing their other full-time professions. Welcome to Hollywood Homicide - the only place where you can come to work hungry, horny, thirsty, and broke, and resolve all four by the end of the watch.

programme.title: The Boondock Saints
programme.desc: Two Irish Catholic brothers become vigilantes and wipe out Boston's criminal underworld in the name of God.

programme.title: Frank Miller's Sin City
programme.desc: In these intertwined tales, a universe of unlikely and reluctant heroes try to do the right thing in a city that refuses to care.

programme.title: Bound
programme.desc: Caesar’s a guy who launders money for the mob. What’s the last thing that would come between a sleazy wise guy like Caesar and that money? A couple of women with brains to die for and bodies to match.

programme.title: Cobweb
programme.desc: Peter confides in his parents (Lizzy Caplan, Antony Starr) about mysterious tapping in his bedroom wall, but they say it’s just an old house. As his fear grows, so do his doubts.

programme.title: The Innkeepers
programme.desc: After over one hundred years of service, The Yankee Pedlar Inn is shutting its doors for good. The last remaining employees - Claire and Luke - are determined to uncover proof of what many believe to be one of New England's most haunted hotels.

programme.title: Cooties
programme.desc: Teachers have the worst Monday ever when their students are turned into little killer savages in this horror comedy with unexpected laughs and unapologetic thrills.

programme.title: Summer Rental
programme.desc: Comedy sensation John Candy plays the stressed-out air traffic controller whose much-needed family holiday yields one hysterical misadventure after another.

programme.title: Look Who's Talking
programme.desc: If you've always wanted to know what a baby thinks of the world around him, you finally have your chance. With Bruce Willis supplying the voice of Mikey's thoughts, this is one baby who says exactly what's on his mind. Rating: PG-13

programme.title: Look Who's Talking Too
programme.desc: John Travolta and Kirstie Alley return in this charming sequel to the $100 million box-office smash. Also starring the voices of Bruce Willis as Mikey, Rosanne Barr as his new baby sister and Mel Brooks as the voice of Mr. Toilet Man.

programme.title: Teen Wolf
programme.desc: A teenage boy's incredible werewolf powers improve the quality of his life in dramatic and hilarious ways.

programme.title: Flight of the Intruder
programme.desc: The target: a missile depot in Hanoi. The plane: the A-6 Intruder, a low-altitude bomber with no defensive weapons. The risk: court-martial at the hands of Commander Camparelli...if they live to return.

programme.title: The Phantom
programme.desc: The story begins as an expedition lands on the island of Bengalla, seeking the Skulls of Touganda. Believed to harness an energy force of power, they could spell disaster for mankind.

programme.title: Seabiscuit
programme.desc: The true story of the undersized Depression-era racehorse whose victories lifted not only the spirits of the team behind it but also those of the nation as well.

programme.title: The Godfather Part II
programme.desc: The continuing saga of a young Vito Corleone growing up in Sicily and in New York during the 1910s and then following Michael Corleone in the 1950s as he tries to expand the family business.

programme.title: Mario Puzo's The Godfather Coda: The Death of Michael Corleone
programme.desc: Director/screenwriter Francis Ford Coppola's definitive new edit and restoration of THE GODFATHER: PART III, with remastered picture and sound. Michael Corleone (Pacino) seeks to free his family from crime and find a suitable successor to his empire.

programme.title: The Firm
programme.desc: Mitch joins a prosperous Memphis firm that affords Mitch and his wife an affluent lifestyle beyond their wildest dreams. But when FBI agents confront him with evidence of corruption and murder within the firm, Mitch sets out to find the truth.

programme.title: The Love Guru
programme.desc: A hilarious comedy starring Mike Myers as guru Pitka in his first original character since the blockbuster hit Austin Powers.

programme.title: Encino Man
programme.desc: Two high school buddies dig up a frozen caveman in their backyard!

programme.title: Southland Tales
programme.desc: SOUTHLAND TALES is an ensemble piece set in the futuristic landscape of Los Angeles, as it stands on the brink of social, economic and environmental disaster. Boxer Santaros (Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson) is an action star who's stricken with amnesia.

programme.title: Bebe's Kids
programme.desc: When ladies' man Robin meets the beautiful Jamika at a funeral service, he feels he must have died and gone to heaven.

programme.title: My Best Friend's Wedding
programme.desc: Commitment-shy Jules Potter reluctantly realizes she is in love with her best friend Michael. There is just one catch: he's about to marry someone else. Jules will do anything to steal him back... except tell him the simple truth.

programme.title: Election
programme.desc: Reese Witherspoon plays Tracy Flick, a straight-A go-getter determined to be president of Carver High’s student body. Popular teacher Jim McAllister (Broderick) decides to derail Tracy’s obsessive overachieving by recruiting an opposition candidate.

programme.title: Lenny
programme.desc: Dustin Hoffman magnificently captures the complexities and contradictions of the legendary comedian Lenny Bruce's mercurial character.

programme.title: Meatballs
programme.desc: Bill Murray stars as Tripper who guides a fun-seeking collection of lovable campers and libidinous staff members through the unique pleasures of a hysterical coed summer experience.

programme.title: The Return of the Pink Panther
programme.desc: The hilarious, accidentally brilliant Inspector Clouseau once again takes on his archenemy, the insane Dreyfus, as he plots to control the world.

programme.title: Face/Off
programme.desc: As a result of a new medical technique, an agent is able to surgically take on the identical appearance of a criminal in order to take down his terrorist organization.

programme.title: Minority Report
programme.desc: In the future, a division of the police department has the technology to arrest killers before they commit crimes; however, the tables turn on one of the cops working within the division.

programme.title: Apocalypto
programme.desc: As the Mayan kingdom faces its decline, a young man is taken on a perilous journey to a world ruled by fear and oppression.

programme.title: Flags of Our Fathers
programme.desc: From Academy Award-winning director Clint Eastwood and Academy Award-winner Steven Spielberg, comes the life stories of the six men who raised the flag at The Battle of Iwo Jima, a turning point in WWII.

programme.title: The Tailor of Panama
programme.desc: Based on the 1996 novel, this is a mixture of thriller and black comedy. Harry Pendel is the tailor to the powerful of Panama. Harry is known for his storytelling and suits, but soon his tales carry lethal repercussions.

programme.title: Texas Rangers
programme.desc: After the Civil War, Texas is at the mercy of murderous bandits. A group of unlikely heroes emerges to battle these renegade outlaws. Out-manned, they summon the courage to protect the innocent and put the wrong things right in their beloved homeland.

programme.title: The Conners
programme.desc: Dan encounters a surprise visitor who shares some unsolicited advice, leaving him feeling guilty; Darlene welcomes a new employee to Wellman Plastics.

programme.title: The Conners
programme.desc: Mark is stressed and exhausted from studying for an important entrance exam, so Darlene steps in to help, but her plan backfires.

programme.title: The King of Queens
programme.desc: With their wives out of town, old buddies Doug and Ray Barone decide to get dressed up and hit a nightclub.

programme.title: The King of Queens
programme.desc: Carrie is asked to bake a cake for the Church bake sale, but she cannot bake.

programme.title: The King of Queens

programme.title: Clue

programme.title: Witness for the Prosecution (1958)
programme.desc: Tyrone Power, Marlene Dietrich and Charles Laughton star in this exceptional courtroom Drama about a young man on trial for a wealthy widow's murder after he suspiciously profits from her will.

programme.title: Ace in the Hole
programme.desc: A cave collapse traps a man, and all eyes turn toward the tragedy, including those of Charles "Chuck" Tatum (Kirk Douglas), a washed-up newspaper reporter who sees the incident as a ticket back to his former days at the top of the journalism heap.

programme.title: The Apartment
programme.desc: Jack Lemmon, Shirley MacLaine and Fred MacMurray are superb in this tale of love and ambition in the world of big business that went on to garner a Best Picture Oscar.

programme.title: Gladiator
programme.desc: A man robbed of his name and his dignity strives to win them back, and gain the freedom of his people, in this epic historical drama from director Ridley Scott.

programme.title: We Were Soldiers
programme.desc: In 1965, America is at war with North Vietnam and Lt. Col. Hal Moore prepares his troops for one of the most violent battles in U.S. History: “The Valley of Death”.

programme.title: Salt
programme.desc: Evelyn Salt swore an oath to duty, honor, and country. She will prove loyal to these when a defector accuses her of being a Russian sleeper spy. Salt goes on the run, using all her skills and years of experience as a covert operative to elude capture.

programme.title: Prowl
programme.desc: A group of friends on their way to the big city are terrorized in an abandoned warehouse where bloodthirsty creatures hunt human prey.

programme.title: Feast
programme.desc: Customers locked inside a bar are forced to fight monsters.

programme.title: The Ruins
programme.desc: "The Ruins" follows a group of friends who become entangled in a struggle for survival after visiting a remote archaeological dig in the Mexican jungle where they discover something deadly living among the ruins.

programme.title: Cabin Fever
programme.desc: A group of kids are trapped in the woods and methodically killed off by a horrifying flesh-eating virus.

programme.title: Purple Rain
programme.desc: Rock star Prince makes a spectacular feature film debut in this highly autobiographical blockbuster that won both an Oscar and a Grammy award.

programme.title: The Pursuit of Happyness
programme.desc: Inspired by the true story about a single father and his young son. Finding themselves homeless, he risks everything on an unpaid internship in a highly competitive stockbroker training program, where only one in twenty interns make the grade.

programme.title: Fences
programme.desc: Set in the 1950s Pittsburgh, the film adaptation of August Wilson’s Pulitzer Prize-winning play takes a passionate look at former baseball player Troy Maxson as he fights to provide for those he loves in a world that threatens to push him down.

programme.title: Kill Zone 2
programme.desc: When his cover gets blown, a Hong Kong cop (Wu Jing) lands in a Thai prison where the warden works with a criminal mastermind (Louis Koo) to harvest organs.

programme.title: Paradox
programme.desc: When his daughter goes missing, a police negotiator (Louis Koo) teams with local police (Tony Jaa) to find her, but instead finds himself embroiled in a web of corruption and violence in this explosive thriller from director Wilson Yip.

programme.title: Triple Threat
programme.desc: This breakneck thriller teams over half a dozen of the world’s biggest action stars for the martial arts event film of the year. When a hit is taken out on a billionaire’s daughter, it’s mercenaries versus assassins in an all-out war.

programme.title: Clue
programme.desc: Meet all the notorious suspects and discover all their foul play things. You'll love their dastardly doings as the bodies and the laughs pile up before your eyes. Featuring all three surprise endings!!

programme.title: Men in Black
programme.desc: Two top secret agents (Will Smith and Tommy Lee Jones) are on a mission of policing alien activities on planet Earth. The Men in Black's current assignment: to stop an intergalactic terrorist from making Earth his next victim.

programme.title: Men in Black II
programme.desc: Agents Jay and Kay are re-teamed against a sinister seductress who represents the toughest challenge yet to the MIB.

programme.title: Dreamland
programme.desc: Discovering a fugitive bank robber (Margot Robbie) is hiding in his small town, a young man is torn between claiming the bounty on her head and his growing attraction to the seductive criminal, in this epic love story set during the Great Depression.

programme.title: Titanic
programme.desc: Leonardo DiCaprio and Oscar-nominee Kate Winslet light up the screen as Jack and Rose, the young lovers who find one another on the maiden voyage of the "unsinkable" R.M.S. Titanic.

programme.title: Jack Ryan: Shadow Recruit
programme.desc: Jack Ryan must quickly evolve from soldier to analyst to full-fledged operative to stop a devastating terrorist plot against the United States.

programme.title: Eagle Eye
programme.desc: Shia LaBeouf and Michelle Monaghan star as two strangers trying to escape danger when they are ripped from their ordinary lives and 'activated' as part of a hightech assassination plot.

programme.title: The Professional
programme.desc: The mysterious Leon (Jean Reno) is New York's top hitman. When his next-door neighbors are murdered, Leon becomes the unwilling guardian of the family's sole survivor - 12-year-old Mathilda (Natalie Portman). Rating:R

programme.title: Trumbo (2015)
programme.desc: Screenwriter Dalton Trumbo's career comes to a crushing halt in the 1940s when he and other Hollywood figures are blacklisted for their political beliefs as he goes to war with the U.S. government and studio bosses over words and freedom.

programme.title: The Wolf of Wall Street
programme.desc: Sex. Money. Power. Drugs. Brace yourself for a true story from legendary filmmaker Martin Scorsese. Leonardo DiCaprio stars as a young stockbroker hungry for a life of non-stop thrills, where corruption was king and more was never enough.

programme.title: The Magnificent Seven (1960)
programme.desc: Yul Brynner stars as one of seven gunslingers pitted against an army of marauding bandits in this rousing classic that made stars of Steve McQueen, Charles Bronson, and James Coburn. Eli Wallach also stars in this timeless tale of good versus evil.

programme.title: Pardners
programme.desc: A rich momma's boy returns west with the son of his murdered father's partner to foil a gang trying to gain control of his family ranch. They accidentally clean up the town.

programme.title: Support Your Local Gunfighter
programme.desc: James Garner is back in the saddle again as hustler Latigo Smith whose latest con is passing off cowhand Jug (Jack Elam) as the dreaded gunman Swifty Morgan. But when the real Swifty shows up, the Wild West is going to get a whole lot wackier!

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Mutant Mayhem
programme.desc: The Turtle brothers take on a mysterious crime syndicate, but they soon get in over their heads when an army of mutants is unleashed upon them.

programme.title: Dungeons & Dragons: Honor Among Thieves
programme.desc: A charming thief and a band of unlikely adventurers undertake an epic heist to retrieve a lost relic. Still, things go dangerously awry when they run afoul of the wrong people in this hilarious and action-packed adventure.

programme.title: Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: The world needed a hero; we got a hedgehog. Superpowered with speed, Sonic races to save the world and stop evil genius Dr. Robotnik from world domination. Jim Carrey, Ben Schwartz, and James Marsden star in the adventure that the whole family will enjoy.

programme.title: A.I. Artificial Intelligence
programme.desc: In a future world, humans share aspects of their lives with companion robots called Mechas. But when an advanced prototype robot child named David is programmed to show unconditional love, his human family isn't prepared for the consequences.

programme.title: The 4:30 Movie
programme.desc: In Kevin Smith's most personal film to date, a teenage cinephile tries to woo the girl of his dreams while dealing with a hilarious mix of friends and enemies at his local cinema.

programme.title: Snack Shack
programme.desc: In Nebraska City, 1991, two best friends get the chance to run the swimming pool snack shack, which later becomes the perfect setting for transgression, fun, personal discovery, and romance.

programme.title: Snowpiercer
programme.desc: After a failed global-warming experiment, a post-apocalyptic Ice Age has killed off nearly all life on the planet.

programme.title: Hyena Road
programme.desc: Three men, three different paths, caught in conflict but brought together to save lives: a highly skilled sniper who can’t think of his targets as human, an intelligence officer who has never killed while on duty.

programme.title: Frank Miller's Sin City
programme.desc: In these intertwined tales, a universe of unlikely and reluctant heroes try to do the right thing in a city that refuses to care.

programme.title: The Babadook
programme.desc: In this terrifying thriller, a mother must protect her son from an evil, supernatural entity that has escaped the pages of a children's book and is lurking in their home.

programme.title: Cobweb
programme.desc: Peter confides in his parents (Lizzy Caplan, Antony Starr) about mysterious tapping in his bedroom wall, but they say it’s just an old house. As his fear grows, so do his doubts.

programme.title: I Saw the TV Glow
programme.desc: Introduced to a mysterious late-night TV show—a vision of a secret, supernatural world beneath his life in the suburbs—teenage Owen's reality begins to crack. A once-in-a-generation horror from Jane Schoenbrun.

programme.title: Look Who's Talking
programme.desc: If you've always wanted to know what a baby thinks of the world around him, you finally have your chance. With Bruce Willis supplying the voice of Mikey's thoughts, this is one baby who says exactly what's on his mind. Rating: PG-13

programme.title: Look Who's Talking Too
programme.desc: John Travolta and Kirstie Alley return in this charming sequel to the $100 million box-office smash. Also starring the voices of Bruce Willis as Mikey, Rosanne Barr as his new baby sister and Mel Brooks as the voice of Mr. Toilet Man.

programme.title: Three Amigos!
programme.desc: Steve Martin, Chevy Chase and Martin Short are three wild and crazy caballeros in this comedy adventure that’s a fiesta of fun. Co-starring Phil Hartman and Jon Lovitz, the '¡Three Amigos!' blaze a side-splitting trail across the comedy frontier!

programme.title: Days of Thunder
programme.desc: Discovered by businessman Tim Daland, Cole is teamed with legendary crew chief and car-builder Harry Hogge to race for the Winston Cup at the Daytona 500. A crash nearly ends Cole’s career and he must turn to a beautiful doctor to regain his nerve.

programme.title: Flight of the Intruder
programme.desc: The target: a missile depot in Hanoi. The plane: the A-6 Intruder, a low-altitude bomber with no defensive weapons. The risk: court-martial at the hands of Commander Camparelli...if they live to return.

programme.title: The Phantom
programme.desc: The story begins as an expedition lands on the island of Bengalla, seeking the Skulls of Touganda. Believed to harness an energy force of power, they could spell disaster for mankind.

programme.title: The Firm
programme.desc: Mitch joins a prosperous Memphis firm that affords Mitch and his wife an affluent lifestyle beyond their wildest dreams. But when FBI agents confront him with evidence of corruption and murder within the firm, Mitch sets out to find the truth.

programme.title: MAFIA
programme.desc: In the 1970s, a fierce crime boss (Ving Rhames) wreaks havoc on the streets. Detective Womack (Pam Grier) decides to put an end to this organized crime – even if it means breaking the law.

programme.title: The Big Hit
programme.desc: Lou Diamond Phillips, Mark Wahlberg, Christina Applegate, Antonio Sabato Jr. and Lela Rochon star in this story of a hitman who kidnaps the teenage child of his boss.

programme.title: Better Luck Tomorrow
programme.desc: To his classmates and teachers, high-schooler Ben Manibag appears to be the model student: a perfectionist and overachiever. But underneath this persona is a darker side. Ben and his bored high-school buddies lead double lives.

programme.title: Drugstore June
programme.desc: After the pharmacy in her small town is robbed, a girl who still lives at home with her parents takes matters into her own hands to solve the crime, while at the same time trying to get over her ex-boyfriend and become more of an adult.

programme.title: Encino Man
programme.desc: Two high school buddies dig up a frozen caveman in their backyard!

programme.title: The Love Guru
programme.desc: A hilarious comedy starring Mike Myers as guru Pitka in his first original character since the blockbuster hit Austin Powers.

programme.title: Grumpy Old Men
programme.desc: Jack Lemmon and Walter Matthau portray lifelong feuding neighbors making each day a hilarious game of revenge. But then voluptuous Ariel moves in nearby and their dormant hormones reignite in an all-out competition to win her favor.

programme.title: Grumpier Old Men
programme.desc: In this sequel to Grumpy Old Men, a vivacious Italian beauty attempts to convert Wabasha, Minnesota's cherished bait store into a romantic Italian restaurant.

programme.title: Bebe's Kids
programme.desc: When ladies' man Robin meets the beautiful Jamika at a funeral service, he feels he must have died and gone to heaven.

programme.title: Revenge of the Pink Panther

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Mr Bean se olvida del cumpleaños de su fiel amigo Teddy. La única que se acordó es la novia de Bean, Irma Gobb. Ahora Mr Bean debe decidir cual será el regalo perfecto para Teddy.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: El juego de croquet de Mr Wicket es interrumpido por un topo ofensivo. Ella le ordena a Bean sacarlo del jardín.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Mr. Bean es atormentado por los fuertes sonidos de obras viales en su calle, y hace todo lo posible para hacerle frente. Intenta de todas maneras frenar el desagradable sonido pero todo es más complicado de lo que parece.

programme.title: Españoles en el Mundo

programme.title: Españoles en el Mundo
programme.desc: Hoy conoceremos Cali, tercera ciudad de Colombia. Descubriremos su entorno natural, su pasado colonial y la alegría y hospitalidad de sus habitantes.

programme.title: Españoles en el Mundo
programme.desc: Hoy viajamos hasta Oxford, exploraremos la vida de sus calles, conoceremos la vida de la Universidad y donde se rodaron escenas de Harry Potter.

programme.title: Españoles en el Mundo
programme.desc: Viajamos hasta el sur de África a un país de naturaleza exuberante, viajamos hasta Botsuana. Nos adentraremos en el Parque Nacional de Chobe, para sentir la vida salvaje en estado puro.

programme.title: Españoles en el Mundo

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
programme.desc: Mista aparece para investigar un ataque desconocido que hace envejecer rápidamente a la tripulación de Bucciarati, pero pronto se verá atrapado por el Stand Beach Boy.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
programme.desc: Conmovido por la determinación del moribundo Prosciutto de mantener activado su Stand Thankful Death, Pesci decide enfrentarse a Bucciarati.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
programme.desc: Melone utiliza el cuerpo de una joven inocente para engendrar un Stand que envía a la caza de Trish, quien muestra signos de ser ella misma una usuaria de Stand.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
programme.desc: Mientras Babyhead intenta hacerlo pedazos mediante la manipulación de la materia, Giorno utiliza los poderes generadores de vida de Golden Wind y contraataca.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
programme.desc: Giorno y Mista llegan a Venecia para recuperar el disco de datos, pero el Stand White Ice de Ghiaccio frustra su misión congelando todo lo que tienen a la vista.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
programme.desc: Bucciarati escolta a Trish hasta el campanario para entregarla finalmente a su padre, pero una devastadora traición pone en peligro la vida de ambos.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
programme.desc: Al darse cuenta de que le habían engañado, Bucciarati decide derrotar a su jefe traidor y salvar a Trish, pero Emperor Crimson sigue llevando las de ganar.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
programme.desc: Ahora que son traidores a Passione, la banda de Bucciarati debe pensar en su próximo movimiento, pero escapar del jefe no será fácil.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
programme.desc: Giorno está incapacitado por el ataque de Squalo y Narancia utiliza su habilidad de radar del Stand Aerosmith para buscar y destruir la amenaza que se aproxima.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
programme.desc: Bucciarati y su tripulación se preparan para partir hacia Cerdeña para descubrir el pasado de su jefe, pero un extraño usuario de Stand aparece antes de que despeguen.

programme.title: Heidi: El puente del diablo
programme.desc: El abuelo tiene que terminar de construir el puente, pero siempre se queda congelado pensando en el accidente que tuvo Tobias, este hecho no lo deja continuar, por lo que Heidi y Clara investigarán para apoyar al abuelo y que pueda superar este trauma.

programme.title: Heidi: Friedrich
programme.desc: La señorita Rottenmeier se encuentra a su ex pareja Friedrich, negando aceptar su pasado quiere salir huyendo para Frankfurt, Clara se niega a irse y se esconde lo cual obliga a la señorita Rottenmeier a pedirle ayuda a Friedrich.

programme.title: Heidi: La silla de ruedas
programme.desc: Pedro esta celoso de que Heidi pasa mayor tiempo con Clara, se enfurece cuando se da cuenta que Heidi e enseña la casa del árbol a Clara.

programme.title: Heidi: Los amigos perdonan
programme.desc: Pedro y Clara se piden disculpas mutuamente por los celos y robarse la atención de Heidi, ambos aclaran la situación deciden realizar un nuevo juramento de amistad acompañados de Heidi en la casa del árbol.

programme.title: Heidi: Edelweiss
programme.desc: La inauguración del Puente se realizará y para celebrar se organizo un pic-nic, donde vienen Clara, la tía de Heidi y el prometido de su tía. La tía se da cuenta que el abuelo es una gran persona y se había equivocado.

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: El juez Beeswax inspecciona la colmena y descubre que Maya vive afuera. Decide expulsarla de la colmena y el prado, creyendo que su estilo de vida es una amenaza para las otras abejas

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Maya y Willy descubren una botella de refresco abandonada. Cuando Willy entra en la botella para degustar el líquido delicioso y dulce, la botella rueda por una pendiente, quitando la pelota de Ben

programme.title: La Abeja Maya

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Willy vio un oso cerca. Maya informa a la Reina, la cual da la orden de evacuar la colmena. Cuando Maya y Willy se dan cuenta de que el pánico en la colmena fue desencadenado por un osito de peluche

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Maya y Willy quieren que Max descubra el delicioso sabor de los frutos de su árbol. Lo llevan por el aire hasta la cima, pero desafortunadamente Max es agarrado por un pájaro

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Willy le teme a las sombras. Para ayudarle a superar su miedo, Maya organiza un espectáculo de títeres de sombras.

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Maya y sus amigos descubren un enorme rastro de baba y las setas de Shelby han desaparecido. Barry sabe con seguridad lo que pasó: hay un monstruo en el prado! Maya decide investigar más y descubre que la criatura es sólo una gran babosa!

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Maya y Willy se encuentran con una bonita oruga llamada Momo, pero él se metamorfosea en una polilla halcón de cabeza muerta y ataca la colmena y comienza a vaciar la miel. Maya tiene que convencer a Momo de que deje la colmena

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Si bien es el gran día de la cosecha de polen, Maya y Willy por error han puesto ha dormir toda la colmena. Ahora tienen que pedirles a todos sus amigos que les ayuden con la cosecha de algas, una flor que florece sólo un día al año.

programme.title: Naruto: Aprobar o reprobar un Examen De Supervivencia
programme.desc: Naruto, Sasuke y Sakura son un equipo, se encuentran con su sensei, Kakashi, él propondrá un examen que solo dos de ellos pueden aprobar, enviando al estudiante que falla a la Academia Ninja. ¡Ellos no saben que alguien haya pasado la prueba de Kakashi!

programme.title: Naruto: ¡Fallaste! La Decisión Final De Kakashi
programme.desc: Naruto, Sasuke y Sakura hacen todo lo posible para aprobar el examen de supervivencia. ¡Pero serán necesarios los sabios consejos de Kakashi para enseñarles a estos ninjas egoístas lo que significa trabajar en equipo!

programme.title: Naruto: ¡Una Misión Peligrosa! Un Viaje A La Tierra De Las Olas
programme.desc: Naruto y sus compañeros comienzan sus primeras misiones ninja. Son tareas aburridas, enojadas y frustradas, y Naruto se alivia diciéndole todo al Hokage. Entretenido por el entusiasmo de Naruto, les asigna una nueva misión: proteger al viejo Tazuna.

programme.title: Naruto: El Asesino De La Neblina
programme.desc: Naruto y su grupo llegan a Tierra de las Olas,donde un malvado hombre llamado Gato se apodero del lugar. Allí aparece Zabuza, contratado por Gato para matar a Tazuna. Naruto está deseando enfrentarse a este asesino ninja. ¿Estará listo para este desafío?

programme.title: Naruto: El Juramento Del Dolor
programme.desc: Kakashi se pone delante durante la batalla contra Zabuza. Pero ¡todo cambia cuando Kakashi es atrapado en la Prisión de Agua de Zabuza! Kakashi pide que huyan, pero Naruto recuerda la promesa que hizo -no volver a huir nunca más- y se mantiene firme!

programme.title: Naruto: Kakashi: Guerrero Sharingan
programme.desc: Gracias al plan de Naruto, Kakashi se libera de la Prisión de Agua y derrota a Zabuza. Un misterioso ninja aparece de repente y acaba con Zabuza antes de que Kakashi lo haga. Naruto se sorprende al ver que un muchacho ha podido derrotar a Zabuza.

programme.title: Naruto: El Bosque Del Chakra
programme.desc: Kakashi no está satisfecho con el resultado de la batalla, cree que Zabuza no ha muerto. Kakashi decide poner en marcha un interesante entrenamiento que permitirá a Naruto, Sasuke y Sakura controlar mejor su chakra.

programme.title: Naruto: El País Donde Existió un Héroe
programme.desc: Sakura y Tazuna van a la aldea, y ven sufrimiento de habitantes de la Tierras a causa de Gato, por eso Tazuna arriesga su vida. Con un puente, los habitantes no dependerían de Gato, quien controla todos los negocios. Naruto y Sasuke continúan entrenando.

programme.title: Naruto: ¡Batalla En El Puente! ¡Zabuza Regresa!
programme.desc: Mientras Naruto se concentra en el entrenamiento, una misteriosa figura aparece y le dice que si alguien tiene el deseo de proteger lo que ama, puede llegar a ser tan fuerte como quiera.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Kenan salva la vida del presidente de los Estados Unidos y es invitado a la Casa Blanca, en donde Kel, accidentalmente, destruye una fotografía muy valiosa.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Kenan intenta invitar a una chica a una cita, que resulta ser la hija del jefe de su padre, el Sr. Dawson, pero en el proceso, Kenan y Kel dejan un mensaje escandaloso en su buzón de mensajes.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Kenan ha ahorrado suficiente dinero para comprar una nueva bicicleta justo a tiempo para Navidad, pero ¿gastará ese dinero solo para él? ¿O habrá un espacio en su corazón para el espíritu navideño?

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Kenan entra en pánico cuando la directora de la escuela pide una reunión con él y sus padres. Pensando que hizo algo malo, decide contratar a dos actores para que hagan de sus padres durante la cita.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Es el Día de Acción de Gracias y el padre de Kenan ha preparado un pavo. Pero cuando nadie está en la cocina, Kel no puede resistir la tentación y se devora el pavo en cuestión de minutos. Ahora Kenan y Kel están en grandes problemas.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Hay una maestra sustituta en la clase y Kel está seguro de que ella está enamorada de Kenan. Kenan no le cree al principio, pero Kel es persistente y persuasivo. Comienza a convencer a Kenan de que puede tener razón.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Kenan y Kel deciden saltarse un día de escuela y trabajo. Se hacen pasar por enfermos, pero pronto se encuentran en grandes problemas, cuando son atrapados en un robo de banco y terminan apareciendo en las noticias.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Kenan y Kel están en el trabajo cuando un payaso de circo entra en Rigby’s y roba la tienda. Las cosas empeoran cuando el mismo payaso aparece más tarde en la fiesta de cumpleaños de Kyra, y los muchachos deciden entrar en acción.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Kel gana 64 millones de dólares en la lotería y quiere dividir el premio con su mejor amigo, Kenan. Parece que las cosas están saliendo bastante bien para ambos, hasta que Kel pierde el billete ganador.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Ishizu, usando la magia de su Collar del Milenio, ya ha visto como termina este duelo - ¡Ella derrotará a Kaiba con su trampa! ¿Cómo puede ganar Kaiba cuando ya está destinada que va a perder?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Mientras que crece la maldad de Marik, Ishizu revela los secretos de su linaje: ¿Cómo Marik se transformó de un niño amable a un tirano buscando poder total? ¿Yugi salvará a Marik del borde de la oscuridad, o eso ya no es posible?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Bakura lucha contra Marik para el dercho de controlar la Barra Milenio y el Anillo Milenio, ¡y el perdedor quedará atrapado dentro del Reino de Sombras para siempre! Para una ventaja, Bakura consigue un aliado con…¿ otro Marik?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Bakura y el Marik bueno convocan el Dragón Alado de Ra, ¡listos para disparar y expulsar el Marik malo al Reino de la Sombras! Pero el Dragón Alado de Ra tiene más de una habilidad especial, ¡y el Marik malo sabe como usarlas todas!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: El dirigible de Kaiba es secuestrado por un niño misterioso llamado Noé y sus secuaces, ¡cinco enemigos familiares del pasado de Yugi y Kaiba que buscan venganza!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: ¡El primero en batirse en duelo bajo el nuevo Sistema de Deck Master es Yugi contra Big 1 Gansley's Deepsea Warrior! ¿Puede Yugi dominar las nuevas reglas complejas, o las reglas lo dominarán?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Mientras Yugi lucha por hacer cara o cruz con el Sistema Deck Master, ¡Big 1 usa su habilidad Deck Master para enviar todos los ataques de Yugi de vuelta! ¿Cómo puede Yugi derrotar a un oponente cuando sus ataques le quitan sus propios puntos de vida?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi se está quedando sin puntos de vida, pero ¿puede su lindo y pequeño Deck Master Kuriboh desatar su furia furiosa para cambiar el rumbo de la batalla?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: ¡Prepárate para una pelea emplumada cuando Téa se enfrenta al Big 2 Crump's Nightmare Penguin donde el perdedor quedará atrapado para siempre en un bloque de hielo!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: A medida que el cuerpo de Téa se convierte cada vez más en una paleta gigante, ¿puede evitar que su cerebro se congele para encontrar una manera de derretir la estrategia de Big 2? ¿O la horda de pingüinos de Big 2 se balanceará sobre ella?

programme.title: Pandemia Tournament
programme.desc: Fecha 7 - 240 equipos se enfrentan a pura acción para hacerse con el título de campeón.

programme.title: Expansion Pack
programme.desc: Es hora de iniciar un nuevo nivel de Expansion Pack, conoceremos cómo surge la ESRB, también veremos la evolución de la legendaria saga “Príncipe de Persia”, y echaremos un vistazo a esos juegos que fueron tan buenos que cambiaron a su género.

programme.title: Expansion Pack
programme.desc: Los Game Awards, en Expansion Pack te volverás experto en uno de los eventos más importantes para el gaming, recordaremos al maravilloso “Pilot Wings 64”, y reconoceremos a los maestros de la música en los videojuegos.

programme.title: Expansion Pack
programme.desc: ¿Conoces las diferencias ente Remaster, Remake y Reboot? En este episodio de Expansion Pack te las contamos. Veremos cómo “Street Fighter”, ha cambiado con el paso de los años; y sentimos el terror con las creepypastas más famosas en videojuegos.

programme.title: La historia detrás de…
programme.desc: Te contamos los detalles detras del desarrollo de Metal Gear Solid, una entrega importante en la historia la cual definio la carrera de Hideo Kojima y el destino de los juegos narrativos.

programme.title: One Piece - Fishman Island Saga
programme.desc: Los Sombrero de Paja siguen luciéndose mostrando sus nuevas armas y habilidades. Ahora es el turno de Franky, quien muestra al mundo las nuevas armas del Soldier Dock System del Sunny.

programme.title: One Piece - Fishman Island Saga

programme.desc: Mientras Naruto se concentra en el entrenamiento, una misteriosa figura aparece y le dice que si alguien tiene el deseo de proteger lo que ama, puede llegar a ser tan fuerte como quiera.

programme.title: Naruto: El Jutsu Secreto De Haku, Los Espejos Cristal De Hielo
programme.desc: Llega el momento de enfrentarse a Zabuza pero en esta ocasión tiene compañía: el ninja rastreador. Él y su compañero se fijan en las habilidades de Sasuke, y los dos se da cuenta del poder que oculta el ninja enmascarado. La batalla comienza.

programme.title: Naruto: El Número Uno Hiperactivo Ninja Cabeza Hueca Entra A Jugar
programme.desc: Sasuke se encuentra en un apuro, pero Naruto acude al rescate. Sasuke tiene un plan para oponerse al jutsu de Haku. Naruto arruina la estrategia de Sasuke y los dos jóvenes ninjas son atrapados.

programme.title: Naruto: Visibilidad Cero: El Sharingan Desquebrajado
programme.desc: Kakashi se da cuenta de que el tiempo apremia y decide usar el Sharingan para derrotar a Zabuza. Pero Zabuza ha preparado una estrategia contra él.

programme.title: Naruto: El Sello Roto
programme.desc: Naruto y Sasuke reciben los ataques de los espejos de hielo de cristal de Haku. Naruto no se para, Sasuke se da cuenta del poder de su propio Sharingan y comienza a evitar ataques. Haku toma a Sasuke por sorpresa, quien protege a Naruto.

programme.title: Naruto: Pasado Blanco: Ambición Escondida
programme.desc: Naruto estalla su ira contra Haku, quien derrotó a Sasuke, desata el poder del Zorro de las Nueve Colas. El chakra de Naruto es tan intenso que incluso alerta a Kakashi y Zabuza, Haku está indefenso ante el poder oculto de Naruto.

programme.title: Naruto: Las Armas Conocidas Como Shinobi
programme.desc: Haku le pide a Naruto que lo termine. Naruto cuestiona a Haku y su existencia solo para luchar y ganar. Kakashi y Zabuza alcanzan el clímax y Kakashi retiene el movimiento de Zabuza. Con la victoria a su alcance, lanza su devastador ataque.

programme.title: Naruto: El Demonio De La Nieve
programme.desc: Naruto enfrenta a Zabuza. Aunque parece no tener emociones, Zabuza está desolado por la pérdida de Haku, la única persona del mundo en la que podía confiar. Naruto se da cuenta de que esta cruel realidad es el destino de los ninjas.

programme.title: Naruto: Un Nuevo Capítulo Comienza: El Examen Chunin
programme.desc: Naruto y compañia regresan a la Aldea Escondida entre las Hojas después de su batalla en la Tierra de las Olas. Aunque cumplen las misiones, Naruto no está satisfecho. Pronto descubre que los extraños están apareciendo en el Leaf Village.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender

programme.title: Naruto: Enciendan Motores: Los Examenes Chunin Comienzan
programme.desc: Naruto y su equipo comienzan la prueba, un examen escrito. El examinador es un jonin llamado Ibiki. Aprobar el examen depende de los tres. Sasuke y Sakura están preocupados de que si Naruto responde mal, también fallarán.

programme.title: Naruto: La Décima Pregunta: Todo O Nada
programme.desc: La parte más difícil es la pregunta número 10. Antes de que escuchen la pregunta, Ibiki explica una regla muy severa: si responden mal a la pregunta, reprobarán el primer examen y el equipo perderá el derecho de tomar otros Exámenes en el futuro.

programme.title: Naruto: Reporte Especial: ¡En Vivo Desde El Bosque De La Muerte!
programme.desc: Konohamaru, el nieto del Tercer Hokage de la Aldea de la Hoja, aparece en el Examen, junto con Moegi y Udon, para cubrir los eventos en el periódico de la Academia Ninja. Konohamaru admira a Naruto y hace entrevistas a los personajes.

programme.title: Naruto: El Examen Chunin Segunda Etapa: El Bosque De La Muerte

programme.title: Naruto: Comer O Ser Comido: Pánico En El Bosque

programme.title: Naruto: El contraataque de Naruto: Nunca Rendirse

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Los Rockmore compran un televisor ultra moderno. Mientras tanto, Chris hace una rifa en Rigby's para sortear un televisor, pero Kel, accidentalmente, se sube encima y lo destroza.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Hay una gran convención de comics en la ciudad y Kenan y Kel no pueden esperar a que llegue el día. Lástima que Kenan tenga que entrenar a la nueva empleada de Rigby's, Sharla, ese mismo día. Los chicos deciden ir de todos modos.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Hay una nueva chica en la clase, Becky. Kel se enamora de ella inmediatamente, cuando descubre que también le gusta la gaseosa de naranja. Pero Kenan está convencido de que su nueva compañera de la escuela es una bruja.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Una estación de radio local está organizando un sorteo y el gran premio son dos entradas para ir a ver al equipo favorito de baloncesto de Kenan y Kel. Para ganar, los muchachos tienen que hacer la pirueta más alocada de todas.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Es la fiesta de aniversario de los padres de Kenan, y Roger está preparando una sorpresa para Sheryl. Lo único que Kenan tiene que hacer es encargarse de ir a buscar el brazalete y el pastel que su padre compró.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Kenan y Kel hacen una prueba de coeficiente intelectual para medir su inteligencia, y Kel, sorpresivamente, obtiene mejores calificaciones que su amigo, así que Kenan sospecha que hubo algún error en los resultados.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Hay una rata suelta en Rigby's que está espantando a todos los clientes. Mientras que Chris quiere llamar a un exterminador para deshacerse de ella, Kel insiste en liberarla y se mete en problemas para salvarle la vida.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Roger y Sheryl llevan Kyra a cenar, mientras que Kenan y Kel se quedan en la habitación de Kenan jugando a un juego de mesa. Cuando terminan de jugar, descubren que unos ladrones se robaron todo.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: ¡Los Cinco Grandes convocan a un dragón todopoderoso que previamente derrotó a Joey, Mai y Mokuba! Joey y Yugi sacan todas las paradas, pero ¿es eso suficiente para evitar que sus mentes se dispersen sobre la realidad virtual?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: ¡Es un duelo por el control de KaibaCorp cuando Noé se enfrenta a Kaiba! Pero, ¿puede Kaiba luchar con toda su fuerza después de enterarse de la verdad oculta sobre Noé ... y el pasado trágico que lo convirtió en lo que es hoy?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: ¡El Arca de Shinato de Noé roba monstruos en su fortaleza para usar como un muro impenetrable de sirvientes! ¿Cómo puede Kaiba lastimar a Noé cuando Noé tiene un flujo interminable de monstruos para protegerse?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: ¡Kaiba está por terminar con Noé, pero Mokuba protege a Noé de su golpe final! ¿Kaiba sacrificará a su amado hermano a cambio de libertad, o el vínculo fraternal seguirá siendo irrompible?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: ¡Por cada turno que pasa, uno de los amigos de Yugi se transforma en piedra! A medida que más y más amigos se endurecen en roca sólida, ¿puede Yugi derrotar a Noé antes de que se quede sin turnos y se transforme en piedra?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Los amigos de Yugi están petrificados en estatuas de piedra sólida, ¡pero sus espíritus viven! Sus almas combinadas energizan a Yugi en una lucha noble, pero ¿el espíritu ganará el duelo cuando Yugi no robe las cartas correctas?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi ha derrotado a Noé ... ¡pero todavía no pueden escapar del mundo virtual! La verdadera razón detrás de su atrapamiento se revela ... ¡como el verdadero villano tirando los hilos!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Mientras Kaiba se enfrenta a su padrastro Gozaburo para su batalla final, Yugi y sus amigos son atacados por un sinfín de hordas de monstruos. Su única esperanza es Noé, pero no pueden esperar la ayuda de su enemigo ... ¿o sí?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: ¡Ya casi se acaba el tiempo antes de que la explosión del misil destruya a Yugi y sus amigos! ¡Los finalistas de Battle City vencerán el reloj y vivirán para duelar otro día en la sorprendente conclusión de la saga del mundo virtual!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: ¡Yugi y sus amigos llegan a la isla KaibaCorp donde los finalistas de Battle City competirán en la arena de duelo final! ¡Prepárate para la increíble batalla real de cuatro personas donde cualquier duelista puede atacar a cualquier otra persona!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Honor, amistad, venganza ... A medida que cada duelista recuerda por qué están luchando, ¡la batalla real continúa donde ninguno de los duelistas sabe de dónde vendrá el próximo ataque!

programme.title: Cybernet LT
programme.desc: ¡Hadouken! Es una de las palabras que resonaron en las salas de arcade y después en nuestros dormitorios gracias al legendario Street Fighter 2. Es por eso que en Cybernet nos enfocamos en el cómo se creó esta importante franquicia

programme.title: Cybernet LT
programme.desc: ¿Cuántos años han pasado desde que se transmitió el último episodio de Cybernet? Desde entonces han habido muchos cambios en los videojuegos. Acompáñanos a través de un recuento de lo más importante que ocurrió durante nuestra ausencia.

programme.title: Cybernet LT
programme.desc: Si eres fan de los videojuegos, probablemente también te gusten los juegos con gráficas retro en pixeles. Hacemos un recuento de los juegos modernos que lucen como clásicos, así como un Top 10 de nuestros soundtracks en chiptunes favoritos.

programme.title: La historia detrás de…
programme.desc: Revisamos la creacion del juego independiente desarrollado por Mojang y Markus Notch Persson que definio la ultima decada. Esta es la historia detras de Minecraft.

programme.title: La historia detrás de…
programme.desc: Revisamos la historia de uno de los oficios más populares de Mario, el de conductor de autos Go Kart.

programme.title: La historia detrás de…
programme.desc: Te contamos los detalles detras del desarrollo de Metal Gear Solid, una entrega importante en la historia la cual definio la carrera de Hideo Kojima y el destino de los juegos narrativos.

programme.title: La historia detrás de…
programme.desc: Recordamos uno de los grandes FPS que revoluciono su genero, de forma mecanica y narrativa. Esta es la historia detras de Half-Life.

programme.title: La historia detrás de…
programme.desc: League of Legends es un exponente independiente que cambio el mundo del entretenimiento digital al formalizar y popularizar el fenomeno de los esports. Hoy es momento de revisar su historia.

programme.title: La historia detrás de…
programme.desc: La sensacion de euforia despues de sobrepasar un gran reto es un sentimiento que muchos esperan de sus juegos favoritos, hasta el grado de que algunos se han vuelto adictos.

programme.title: La historia detrás de…
programme.desc: De la mano de Bungie, creadores de Halo, llego una nueva franquicia que mezclaria elementos miticos y legendarios en un formato de mundo compartido resultando en un producto diferente pero exitoso

programme.title: La historia detrás de…
programme.desc: Te contamos la novedosa transición generacional del bombardero azul de Capcom. Esta es la historia de Mega Man X.

programme.title: La historia detrás de…
programme.desc: Los videojuegos basados en series animadas han sido parte integral del éxito de la industria. Hoy veremos su historia

programme.title: La historia detrás de…
programme.desc: Te contamos la historia de Rare y el juego que causo los celos de Shigeru Miyamoto

programme.title: La historia detrás de…
programme.desc: Repasamos la historia del RPG de accion por excelencia

programme.title: La historia detrás de…
programme.desc: Hoy hablaremos del juego de plataformas 2D por excelencia y su impresionante salto entre los 8 y 16 bits. Esta es la historia detras de Super Mario World

programme.title: La historia detrás de…
programme.desc: Te contamos sobre la arriesgada apuesta de Gearbox Software que dio origen al genero Loot Shooter como lo conocemos. Esta es la historia de Borderlands.

programme.title: La historia detrás de…
programme.desc: Te contamos la histroia de Super Metroid, un titulo de calibre legendario que estuvo 3 veces en el borde de la cancelacion.

programme.title: La historia detrás de…
programme.desc: Te contamos la historia detras de Final Fantasy VII, el juego de Square que popularizo los RPG en todo el mundo. Final Fantasy VII llevo al genero y a los videojuegos mas alla de sus limites.

programme.title: La historia detrás de…
programme.desc: En los 90, nadie hubiera imaginado que Nintendo estuviera al frente del genero de peleas con el titulo con mayor presencia y mejores ventas en la industria de los videojuegos
